author: CthulhuBeard
quote:
if i was to rate this as a stand alone game, it would be closer to a 5/10.

but it's not a new game. it's not GTA at home, it's GTA. it's got a bigger map, it looks marginally better than the previous game, but it's not like the last game came out a couple years ago.

bland characters. horrible writing. nanny systems to not let you just do anything like true GTA. teleporting omniscient NPCs that know what a sniper is looking at them. gotta play 30+ hours before it starts having a little bit of fun.

minus points for all that. and on top of it, they are funneling all our interactions in the game to their Ai subsidiary to sell our individualized (ip adress, account # etc linked) user information down to the milisecond, in how we respond to things, what we do, how re react, all while lying about it, and selling that data to others.

not to mention bugs as bad or worse than Cyberpunk 2077 at launch. some bugs is normal, but this game is just pathetic. rivals that last reboot of Saints Row.
